Meaning

boxes.title: Orders: added detail
items: Zakariya backed ==**Iltutmish against Qabacha**==; Suhrawardis adopted sama and raqs
Later Deccan Chishtis accepted grants; centres **Gulbarga, Bijapur**
Naqshbandis: no **breath control**; condemned **bid'at**; opposed Shia influence
Firdausi: Suhrawardi branch (also Kubrawiya); ⚠ "Sind and Lahore", "Sheikh Nizamat-ullah" = Qadiri
Ulema = Shariat orthodoxy; Sufis freely used music
Sufis absorbed **Vedanta, Yoga, Neo-Platonism**; met **Kanphata (Nath)** yogis
**Alberuni**: Sufi ideas like **Patanjali's Yoga Sutra** and the Gita
